subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should extension-relay publicly expose nonce-scoped opaque stable target handles, replacing the raw renderer target IDs that existing CDP consumers may observe?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive external relay identity contract; source review can validate mechanics but cannot choose the intended permanent CDP-facing behavior for existing consumers.

options.title: Confirm opaque stable handles
options.body: Adopt nonce-scoped relay-owned handles as the public contract, contingent on live paired-extension proof of reattach continuity and stale-handle retirement.

options.title: Preserve raw renderer IDs
options.body: Keep the existing externally observed raw target IDs and narrow this PR to backend-owned route outcomes until a separately designed relay API migration is approved.

options.title: Pause relay identity work
options.body: Merge neither public-ID change nor compatibility claim until the browser owner defines the supported extension-relay target identity contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm opaque stable handles
recommendation.body: Adopt nonce-scoped relay-owned handles as the public contract, contingent on live paired-extension proof of reattach continuity and stale-handle retirement.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical report defines the required relay identity lifecycle and the PR discussion explicitly requests this person's contract confirmation.
